profile.headline: Creative Software Architect and Academic
profile.summary:
Software Engineer with substantial experience in software architecture and several different database engines and development platforms.  Special interest in research, reuse and usability, intending to pursue a Ph.D. with emphasis in assistive technology.
Closely linked to the academic field for most of my professional life, having managed educational programs on technology, from elementary school to Masters level.

Specialties: MS SQL Server, Delphi, Visual Basic, ASP, PHP, CSS, intellectual property, software engineering, software architecture, software reuse, usability, development for mobile platforms, embedded systems, GIS
